title: Cambridge Hospital Jeddah
hero.text: A leading long-term care & rehabilitation hospital in Western Saudi Arabia

text: Cambridge Hospital Jeddah is a leading long-term care and rehabilitation hospital in the Western Region of Saudi Arabia, providing specialised medical care for patients with complex and chronic conditions. The hospital delivers integrated clinical services through multidisciplinary teams, ensuring continuity of care throughout the recovery journey.

Following its expansion and comprehensive refurbishment, the hospital has further strengthened its position as a regional provider of post-acute and rehabilitation care. With advanced clinical capabilities, international accreditations and expanding capacity, Cambridge Hospital Jeddah is well positioned to meet the growing demand for specialised long-term care and rehabilitation services across Saudi Arabia.
